title: A Happy Breakfast
setting: A small house in the morning: a bathroom and a bright kitchen.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

sentences.en: The morning sun comes up in the east.
sentences.zh: 早晨的太阳从东方升起。
sentences.scene_prompt: The morning sun rises over the roofs, seen through a kitchen window.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the sun rising; the direction 'east' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Ben changes his wet socks in the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 本在卫生间换下湿袜子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits in a small bathroom and pulls on dry socks, wet socks on the floor.

sentences.en: Mum makes tea, her favorite morning drink.
sentences.zh: 妈妈泡茶，那是她早上最喜欢的饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) pours hot tea from a teapot into a cup in the kitchen, smiling.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Mum making tea; that it is her favorite can't be shown.

sentences.en: Ben gets bread and a sharp knife.
sentences.zh: 本拿来面包和一把锋利的刀。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) takes a loaf of bread and a knife from the kitchen counter.

sentences.en: He cuts the bread into eighteen thin pieces.
sentences.zh: 他把面包切成十八片薄片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) cuts a loaf of bread into many thin slices on a wooden board.
sentences.draw_note: Shows many thin slices; the exact number can't be read.

sentences.en: Breakfast is ready, and it is time to eat.
sentences.zh: 早餐准备好了，该吃饭了。
sentences.scene_prompt: A kitchen table set with bread, tea, cups and plates, ready for breakfast.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a breakfast table ready; 'it is time' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Ben sits down between Lily and the window.
sentences.zh: 本在莉莉和窗户之间坐下。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits down at the table between Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) and a sunny window.

sentences.en: Lily says thanks, and they both laugh.
sentences.zh: 莉莉说了声谢谢，两人都笑了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) takes a slice of bread from Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and they laugh together at the breakfast table.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily taking bread and both laughing; the word 'thanks' can't be shown.
